A '''medpac''' (also '''med-pack''', '''medi-pack''',<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref><ref name="HSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>, '''health pack''',<ref name="JK">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> or '''medi-kit''', not to be confused with the larger [[medkit]]) was a small first-aid kit that contained limited-utility diagnosis equipment and other essential medicines for the treatment of wounds.

==Description==
A medpac usually contained diagnostics such as [[Medical scanner/Legends|medisensors]] and also could provide [[Flexclamp/Legends|flexclamps]], [[Synthflesh/Legends|synthflesh]],<ref name="HSR" /><ref name="HSE" /> [[irrigation bulb]]s,<ref name="HSR" /><ref name="HSE" /> [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]], [[Spray-bandage/Legends|spray-bandages]], bacta patches, spray hypos, bone stabilizers, [[antiseptic]]s, medical drugs, [[coagulant]]s,<ref name="TRG1" /> stimulants such as [[stim-shot]]s, and other essential medicines for the treatment of wounds.

==Usage==
[[File:Medpac_scale.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A medpac in use]]
They were standard-issue for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and were the standard method of treating minor injuries or providing crisis care in the civilized portions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Variants==
A [[medkit]] was a bulkier variant used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

During the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] '''advanced medpacs''' were also frequently available. These kits contained more equipment than the standard medpac, for the treatment of serious wounds. Furthermore, in rare instances, a [[life support pack]] was obtainable at some of the more exclusive traders. This item contained highly advanced dermal regenerators and other necessary medical equipment for the treatment of life-threatening wounds.
